{{Top}}
The '''Festival of Glad Arrival''' was a springtime celebration that was held in the meadows of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Lake Country. It was known for its brilliantly colorful [[Parade/Legends|parades]] and jovial music. It was organized by the [[Pastoral Collective/Legends|Pastoral Collective]].
